Theorem
1. Theorem 1.14\group harmonic-functions Source: han-lin-lecture-notes:page-0011 ↗ hanlin:lemma-higher-derivative-estimate Every harmonic function is real analytic.
Proof

\sketch Taylor-expand in a ball $B_{2R}(x)$. Lemma 1 bounds the order-$m$ remainder by a geometric factor $((n^2e)|h|/R)^m\max _{B_{2R}(x)}|u|$, which tends to zero for sufficiently small $|h|$. Thus the Taylor series converges to $u$ locally.

□
